name: Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān al-Ṭūsī
summary: Lexicographer who learned from the Kufans and Basrans, above all Ibn al-Aʿrābī, and quarrelled with Ibn al-Sikkīt over the books of their teacher Naṣrān al-Khurāsānī.
bio: Al-Ṭūsī learned from the shaykhs of the Kufans and the Basrans, most of all from Ibn al-Aʿrābī. He and Ibn al-Sikkīt had both learned from Naṣrān al-Khurāsānī and became enemies over his books after his death. He left no written work.
Al-Zubaydī counts a 'al-Ṭūsī' in the fourth generation of the lexicographers of Kufa.
uncertain: That al-Zubaydī's al-Ṭūsī (kufa-lugha, fourth generation) is this Abū al-Ḥasan rests on the name and the generation.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 241–242
